description: Area stradale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pieveanievole.ldpgis.it. Dataset contenente la superficie compresa entro i confini stradali. È il piano formato dalla carreggiata e dalle fasce di pertinenza, cioè banchine, marciapiedi e piste;può comprendere differenti tipi di viabilità sia pedonale che su gomma o di altro tipo, come quella tranviaria. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include progetto-opendata-highvalue. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, ZIP, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
